events.verdict: Murray (DEN) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Durant (PHX).
Porter Jr. (DEN) brings his hand to Booker's (PHX) body at the start of the drive and then removes it as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Gordon (DEN) moves alongside Booker's (PHX) path as both players come together at the end of the drive as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Gordon (DEN) legally contests Booker's (PHX) driving shot attempt.
Plumlee (PHX) absorbs the contact to Jokic's (DEN) body during Jokic's drive in the post.
Booker (PHX) briefly grasps Jokic's (DEN) jersey in the post before releasing.
Durant (PHX) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Porter Jr. (DEN) brings his hand to Allen's (PHX) side at the start of the drive, and immediately removes as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Allen (PHX) is still in possession of the ball when the shot clock expires, and a 24 Second Violation is correctly assessed.
Jokić (DEN) gathers the pass on his right foot and takes one step, establishing his left foot as his pivot, which he maintains prior to starting his dribble.
Jokić (DEN) goes to, not through, Plumlee's (PHX) space and marginal contact occurs as Jokić releases away during the drive.
Porter Jr. (DEN) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Plumlee (PHX) as the steal occurs.
Plumlee (PHX) brings his arm down and marginal contact with Porter Jr.'s (DEN) upper body during his play at the basket.
Porter Jr. (DEN) initiates contact to Durant's (PHX) lower body and arm during his upward shooting motion, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Beal (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Murray (DEN).
The ball is last touched by Beal (PHX) prior to it going out of bounds.
Durant (PHX) avoids stepping out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Jokić (DEN) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
